#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int mod = 998244353;

long long fastpow(long long n, long long ti) {
    if (ti == 0) 
        return 1LL;
    if (ti % 2 == 0) {
        long long y = fastpow(n, ti / 2);
        long long k = y * y % mod;
        return k;
    } else {
        long long y = fastpow(n, ti / 2);
        long long k = ((n * y) % mod) * y % mod;
        return k;
    }
}

long long modInv(long long x) {
    return fastpow(x, mod - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    if (l == r) {
        cout << 1 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    long long odds = ((r + 1) / 2) - (l / 2);
    long long evens = (r / 2) - ((l - 1) / 2);

    long long ans;

    if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
        ans = fastpow(odds + evens, n * m);
    } else {
        ans = (fastpow(odds + evens, n * m) + fastpow(odds - evens, n * m)) % mod;
        ans = (ans * modInv(2)) % mod;
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
